description:
Atmosphere in the Cathedral of Pisa, Italy (binaural, please use headset for 3D effects). 
I made this recording in the Cathedral of Pisa, in Italy. 
One can hear tourists passing by while talking or whispering, and some noises in the distance. 
Recorded in April 2024 with an Olympus LS-P4 and Ohrwurm 3D binaural microphones. 
Fade in/out and high pass filter at 60Hz -6dB/oct applied in Audacity. 
(If you want to use this sound as a mono audio file, you may have to delete one channel to avoid phase issues).
name: 240415_2716_IT_Cathedral_of_Pisa
